'''Business and economy'''
*[[2026 Bangladesh garment workers protests]]
** [[Bangladesh]]i [[Bangladesh Police|police]] and 42 [[platoon]]s of the [[Border Guard Bangladesh]] deploy [[tear gas]], [[stun grenade]]s, [[baton (law enforcement)|baton]]s, and [[unmanned aerial vehicle|surveillance drones]] during clashes with thousands of [[Textile industry in Bangladesh|garment workers]] across [[Dhaka]], [[Savar Upazila|Savar]], [[Ashulia]], [[Gazipur District|Gazipur]], and [[Narayanganj District|Narayanganj]] demanding a monthly [[minimum wage]] increase from [[Bangladeshi taka|৳]]12,500 ([[US$]]100) to ৳30,000 ($240). Protesters block the [[N3 (Bangladesh)|N3]], [[N4 (Bangladesh)|N4]], and [[N5 (Bangladesh)|N5]] highways and force the closure of at least 37 [[factory|factories]] after a [[minimum wage|Minimum Wage Board]] meeting is postponed to November 23.
